dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: My most distinguished guests! Please hear me!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: I'm sure you have watched the first four acts. I hope you've enjoyed the show!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: The stage is now set for the final act! Ahh, I'm so excited, I could cry!

dialogues.speaker: Twilight Theater Head
dialogues.text: There is still something I need to follow up with backstage. I am terribly sorry that I cannot escort you to the final stage personally, but... I'll see you there!
